TRANSFERANDDISTRIBUTION OFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS PURSUANT TO SECTION 98-33(a) OF THE ZONING RESOLUTION OF THECITY OF NEWYORK 2011, by WEST 30TH HIGHLINE HOLDINGS, L.L.C., a New York limited liability company,with an address at c/oRelated,60 Columbus Circle,New York,NewYork 10023 ("Transferor"), and WEST 30TH HIGHLINE HOLDINGS, L.L.C., a New York limited liability company, with an address at c/o Related, 60 Columbus Circle, New York, New York 10023 ("Transferee"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner in fee simple of certain real property, in the City of New York, designated as Block 701, Lots 30 and 44 on the Tax Map of New York and more particularly described in Exhibit I attached hereto and made a part hereof (said real property being hereinafter called the “Granting Parcel"); and WHEREAS, Granting Parcel is currently vacant and undeveloped; and WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of the unused floor area and other development rights appurtenant to Granting Parcel; and WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain real property designated as Block 701, Lots 16, 52, 55, 56 and 58, as shown on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit II attached hereto and made a part hereof (said property being hereafter called the “Receiving Parcel"); and WHEREAS, the Granting Parcel is a “granting site” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the “Zoning Resolution"); and WHEREAS, the Receiving Parcel is a “receiving site” as defined in Section 98- 33 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, certain “floor area,” as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution,allowablefor the development of the Transfer Lots is unused and is available for transfer under Section98-30 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor has notified the City Planning Commission of New York City (hereinafter,the“CPC")of their intent to transfer 15,031 square feet of floor area, (hereinafter, the "Development Rights") from the Granting Parcel to the Receiving Parcel ；and WHEREAS, a primary access easement has been provided on the Granting Parcel,pursuant to Section 98-60 of the Zoning Resolution and an Access Easement
